recipes.title: Warm Microwave Chickpea and Spinach Salad
recipes.description: A quick warm salad featuring tender chickpeas, juicy cherry tomatoes, and wilted spinach tossed in olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
steps: Rinse and drain the canned chickpeas. Halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the lemon in half.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, and olive oil.
Cover the microwave-safe bowl with a paper towel and microwave on high for 2 minutes until hot.
Carefully remove the bowl from the microwave and stir in the fresh spinach, allowing the residual heat to wilt the leaves.
Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the warm mix, toss well to coat, and divide between two serving bowls.
recipes.why: This recipe makes great use of your fresh spinach and cherry tomatoes, which are marked to use soon, combining them into a simple microwave meal within your 15-minute timeframe.

recipe.title: Cold Chickpea, Tomato, and Spinach Salad
recipe.description: A crisp, fresh salad combining tender canned chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, and fresh spinach tossed with olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
steps: Rinse and drain the canned chickpeas thoroughly. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and slice the lemon in half.
In a large serving bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, and fresh spinach leaves.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fresh ingredients and squeeze the juice from the lemon halves directly into the bowl.
Toss all ingredients together until evenly coated and divide between two plates to serve cold.
recipe.why: This salad makes great use of your spinach and cherry tomatoes (which are marked to use soon) without requiring any heating appliances.
recipe.adjustmentSummary: Adapted the recipe for cold preparation by removing the microwave step and equipment. The ingredients are now tossed raw and served chilled.
